children: Nexon Omniverse, the parent company of value fashion retailer Style Union, has raised Rs 485 crore (around USD 52 million) in a Series E funding round led by Venturi Partners and co-led by Elev8 Venture Partners. The funding round comprises a combination of primary and secondary capital, as per a media report.

The fresh capital will be used to expand Style Union’s physical store network across key metropolitan markets, according to media reports, enabling the retailer to strengthen its presence beyond southern India and enter more western and northern markets.

Founded in 2022 by Ekta Biyani, wife of businessman Rakesh Biyani, Style Union is a fast-fashion and value-retail brand offering affordable everyday apparel, athleisure, ethnic wear, accessories and makeup for men, women and children through online and offline channels.
The company currently operates 200 stores across Karnataka, Telangana, Andhra Pradesh, Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Gujarat, Maharashtra and Delhi-NCR.
Style Union has expanded its store network from 41 outlets in FY23 to 158 in FY26. During the same period, its net revenue increased from Rs 123 crore to more than Rs 1,150 crore.

The company is also backed by investors including B2V Ventures, Manish Chokhani, Rafique Malik of Metro Brands, Ashish Kacholia, Sharrp Ventures, Elcid Investments and the Capri Global family office, among others.
